credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Depicts Catherine O'Keeffe, one of the artist's four sisters. Graphite sketch the artist's sister with a hat. The drawing is located slightly to the lower right of the center of the paper and is surrounded by negative space. The girl is drawn in profile, from the lower legs on up. Her hands are clasped in front of her and she is looking downward, facing the left side of the paper. She has a braid in her hair and a large bow on her hat that is heavily shaded. She wears a knee length dress with a bow around the midsection. Signed and dated, lower right hand corner.
title: Untitled (Catherine O' Keeffe)
